summary.text: Robert Leadbeter is the Republican incumbent, in office since December 1, 2022, seeking re-election to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 109, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as business executive.

paragraphs.text: Robert Leadbeter earned a B.B.A. and an M.B.A. from Capella University, and his career experience includes working as a business executive.
He succeeded David Millard in the District 109 seat, and his 2023-2024 committee assignments, as listed by Ballotpedia, were Insurance and Judiciary.
